clauses.why: The brethren brought Saul down to Caesarea and sent him on to Tarsus; he was not sent from Caesarea.
clauses.english: was where the brethren sent Saul
clauses.spa: adonde los hermanos enviaron a Saulo

clauses.english: was where Barnabas went to seek Saul and bring him to Antioch
clauses.ukr: куди Варнава подався шукати Савла, щоб привести його в Антіохію
clauses.deu: wohin Barnabas zog, um Saulus zu suchen und ihn nach Antiochien zu führen
clauses.spa: adonde Bernabé partió a buscar a Saulo para traerlo a Antioquía
